name: io.github.Servosity/datto-saas-mcp
title: Datto SaaS Protection MCP
description: Every Datto SaaS Protection (Backupify) client in one local database: seat audits, protection gaps

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank for the Datto API host (https://api.datto.com/v1); set it only to send requests through your own proxy or a test server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DATTO_SAAS_PUBLIC_KEY credential for the Datto SaaS Protection MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the DATTO_SAAS_SECRET_KEY credential for the Datto SaaS Protection MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read tools: datto-saas_execute refuses the seat bulk change, and sync, export and the other commands that change state are not offered. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off and sync is refused. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to the Datto API. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.

environmentVariables.name: DATTO_SAAS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
